picker_dollies.configuration.title: Picker Dollies Configs
picker_dollies.configuration.maxBlocks.t: Maximum number of blocks supported per operation. In practice this limits the size of the initial selection.
picker_dollies.configuration.wandItem.to: Item that will be used to perform operations using this mod. All the functionality of this item will be replaced, so pick something you won't be using.
picker_dollies.configuration.shouldRende: Determines if a preview for an operation result should be displayed, for example for a move operation this will be the blocks that will be placed. This feature is not super optimised, so disable this if you get frame drops.
picker_dollies.configuration.displayDire: When using the wand, displays an indicator next to your crosshair that shows which in axis the active area will move when scrolling.
gui.picker_dollies.new_selection: Press %s to to start new selection
